hero.title: WITM
hero.subtitle: Who Is The Most...?
hero.description: The party game where you vote on your friends — and they vote on you. Who's getting dared tonight?

about.title: A Small Swiss Team, Big Ideas
about.description: We're a passionate team from Fribourg, Switzerland, dedicated to bringing friends together through fun and unforgettable moments.
about.story: WITM was born from a simple question: "Who among us is the most likely to...?" Now you can settle the debate! Create a room, invite your friends with a PIN code, and vote on hilarious questions. The one with the most votes? They get a dare! Plus, with Collaborative Questions, your group can create and submit your own questions in real time.

createRooms.title: Quick Room Setup
createRooms.description: Create a room in seconds and share a 3-digit PIN. Friends join instantly - no accounts needed!

funQuiz.title: Vote on Friends
funQuiz.description: Fun questions like "Who is the most likely to..." appear — plus your group can submit custom questions on the spot. Everyone votes secretly for who fits best!

dynamicVoting.title: Reveal & Dare
dynamicVoting.description: See who got the most votes! The winner gets a fun dare or challenge from the group.

leaderboard.title: Final Rankings
leaderboard.description: At the end, discover who was voted "The Most" throughout the game. Bragging rights included!

whyChoose.title: Why Choose WITM?
whyChoose.subtitle: The party game made for real friendships
whyChoose.swissMadeDesc: Designed and developed with Swiss precision and care in Fribourg. Quality you can trust.
whyChoose.weListenDesc: Have an idea? We read every suggestion. Your feedback directly shapes our features.
whyChoose.justLaunchedDesc: We ship new features every month — more questions, categories, and game modes are always on the way.
whyChoose.communityFirstDesc: Built for friend groups, shaped by players like you. You are the heart of WITM.

feature1.title: Create or Join in Seconds
feature1.description: Starting a game is effortless. Create a room and get a unique 3-character PIN code. Share it with friends via text, and they're in! No sign-up required for guests.
feature1.bullet2: Minimum 2-3 players to start the fun

feature2.title: Who Fits the Question Best?
feature2.description: A hilarious question pops up and everyone secretly picks the friend who fits it most. Who's the biggest drama queen? Who'd survive on a desert island? Your crew decides!
feature2.extra: Every round is a new debate. Some answers are obvious, some will shock you. The best part? Watching your friends try to justify their votes. Whether it's about hidden talents or embarrassing habits, the group always knows.

feature3.title: Vote for Who Fits Best
feature3.description: Each round, a question appears: "Who is the most likely to...?" Everyone votes secretly for the friend they think matches best. Be honest... or be strategic!
feature3.bullet2: Optional anonymous mode hides who voted for whom
feature3.bullet3: Self-vote toggle for even more fun

feature4.title: Live Results, Real Reactions
feature4.description: Watch the votes roll in live! See who's getting picked and enjoy the real-time reactions when the winner is revealed. The tension builds with every vote.
feature4.extra: Votes update in real time so everyone can feel the suspense. When the final tally drops, expect gasps, laughs, and a whole lot of finger-pointing. That's where the real fun begins.

feature5.title: Results & Dares
feature5.description: After voting, the results are revealed! The person with the most votes is crowned "The Most" for that round and receives a dare or fun challenge from the group.
feature5.extra: The game automatically advances after each round. Configure 5 to 20 questions per game, with timers from 5 to 30 seconds. Every setting is customizable!

feature6.title: Share the Laughs
feature6.description: Screenshot your funniest results and share them with the world. Show everyone who got voted 'Most likely to become a cat lady' — they'll never live it down.
feature6.extra: The best WITM moments deserve an audience. Share your results on social media, challenge other friend groups to play, and compare who got the wildest votes. Every game creates stories worth telling.

feature7.title: Final Leaderboard
feature7.description: At the end, see the complete leaderboard showing who was voted "The Most" across all rounds. Perfect for settling friendly debates and earning bragging rights!
feature7.extra: Premium players can create custom questions, access all categories, and personalize every game setting. Make WITM truly yours!

faq.sectionDescription: Everything you need to know about WITM
faq.a1: You need at least 2 players to start a game. There's no upper limit — the more friends, the more fun! Just share the PIN code and everyone can join instantly.
faq.a2: Yes! WITM is completely free to download and play. We offer an optional premium upgrade for custom questions, extra categories, and more game settings.
faq.q3: Can I create my own questions?
faq.a3: Absolutely! Premium users can create custom question lists. Plus, with Collaborative Mode, everyone in the lobby can submit questions before the game starts — no premium needed!
faq.a4: Collaborative Mode lets every player in the lobby submit their own questions before the game begins. These are mixed with the category questions for a totally unique game experience. Perfect for inside jokes!
faq.q5: How do I join a room?
faq.a5: The host creates a room and gets a 3-character PIN code. Just enter this PIN on the join screen and you're in! No account needed to join as a guest.
faq.q6: Is WITM available in my language?
faq.a6: WITM is currently available in English, French, and German — with all 520+ questions fully translated. More languages are coming soon based on community requests!

testimonials.sectionDescription: Real stories from real game nights

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.quote: We played for 3 hours straight and couldn't stop laughing. The questions are spot-on and the dares made it legendary.

reviews.name: Lucas D.
reviews.quote: Way better than boring icebreakers. Our team actually got to know each other. The anonymous mode is genius!

reviews.name: Emma K.
reviews.quote: Even my parents got into it! The Family category is perfect — funny but never too awkward. We play every Sunday now.

reviews.name: Maxime R.
reviews.quote: The Collaborative Questions feature is a game-changer. Everyone adds their inside jokes and it becomes SO personal.
